name: Danganronpa SE: Twilight of Ceres
source:
Sixteen students find themselves trapped in Ceres Academy by an eccentric headmaster, with only one way out.

The plot follows Mari Aitoji, the Ultimate Journalist, who has been scouted by Ceres Academy to attend their prestigious school. In a world that revolves around the Ultimate system, who could deny such an opportunity?

[From [url=https://gamejolt.com/games/DanganronpaSE/1041969]GameJolt[/url]]
translation:
十六名学生发现自己被一位古怪的校长困在谷神星学院，只有一条出路。

剧情讲述终极记者Mari Aitoji被Ceres学院发掘进入他们的名校。在终极系统的世界里，谁能拒绝这样的机会呢？
